## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check` and `uv run ruff format --check` pass
- [ ] `uv run mypy src tests` passes
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes (state whether PostgreSQL integration tests ran)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, account data or real portfolio data committed
- [ ] Any new exchange behaviour is cited from official docs or marked **unverified**

- [ ] Docs updated
